corruptions.implementation: byte-identical operator code copied from prospective Phase 3A
corruptions.scope: deterministic clean-room ImageNet-C-style categories; not bitwise or severity-equivalent to official CIFAR-C or ImageNet-C

data_provenance.training_split: class-stable first 4000 of 5000 training images per class

image_partitions.note: disjoint within Phase 3B and unused by Phase-2 through 2E banks; some images were included in historical Phase-1 broad confirmation and are not claimed globally untouched

method_development.confirmation_behavior_access: forbidden until fitted method file is committed
method_development.fit_access: Phase-3B development calibration and target outcomes only
method_development.primary: order-blind symmetric ridge using all thirty directed pairs
method_development.structural_change_from_phase3a: CIFAR-10 chance floor 0.1 replaces CIFAR-100 chance floor 0.01; all other method structure and seven gates are retained

primary_gates: symmetric macro normalized MAE below metadata/clean ridge
family/lineage/reversal hierarchical 95% improvement CI excludes zero
at least four of six coordinate MAEs improve
symmetric macro normalized MAE below both independent and envelope formulas
symmetric macro controlled model-rank Spearman improves
symmetric accuracy top-1 selection regret is no worse
at least five of six family mean improvements are positive
replication_reporting: report direction agreement with Phase 3A for every gate and all six coordinate MAEs; this descriptive comparison cannot alter the primary gate
